name: METAPOD CO2 Gas Regulator Flowmeter with 220V Electric Preheater
shortDescription: Heavy forged brass CO2 gas pressure regulator featuring integrated 220V electric heating jacket and precision polycarbonate flowmeter column (0-25 L/min).
overview: The METAPOD heated CO2 gas regulator and flowmeter is an essential control device for high-duty MIG/MAG welding setups using 100% carbon dioxide shielding gas. Expanding high-pressure liquid CO2 causes severe thermodynamic refrigeration that typically freezes standard unheated regulators, blocking gas flow and causing catastrophic weld porosity. This unit features an internal 220V 190W heating element enclosed in a forged solid brass body that continuously warms the gas stream. The impact-resistant polycarbonate flowmeter tube allows ultra-accurate gas flow metering from 0 to 25 litres per minute.
keyFeatures: Integrated 220V AC electric preheater prevents gas freeze-up and flow interruptions
Solid forged brass body with sintered bronze inlet filter for durability
Dual gauge configuration: High pressure cylinder gauge + precision vertical flowmeter
Accurate flow calibration from 0 to 25 L/min for optimal weld pool shielding
Thermal cutoff thermostat prevents overheating during standby periods
Heavy-duty brass knob for sensitive pressure and flow regulation
Standard CGA-320 / BSP 5/8" bottle connector with leak-proof neoprene seal

specifications.Outlet Connection: 8 mm (5/16") Hose Nipple with Swivel Nut

applications: Continuous production MIG/MAG welding with 100% CO2 gas
Automated robotic welding cells operating at high duty cycles
Heavy structural fabrication workshops and outdoor pipe yards
